rationale: Weekly profile mandates fresh X-native Grok Source Intake before Discovery acceptance. W43 window Oct 16 18:00 EDT to Oct 23 18:00 EDT (UTC Oct 16 22:00 to Oct 23 22:00). Sol handles Drive task/result handoff and faithful edition-local import as permitted; Muse proceeds with parallel public source research and marks X_INTAKE_PENDING truthfully.

research_questions: What technically material X-native developments appeared in the ordinary W43 window?
What did independent maintainers/evaluators reproduce, integrate or falsify (license/weights, local deployment, benchmarks, security failures)?
Which primary artifacts must be verified before inclusion (model cards, repos, licenses)?
Distinguish post-in-window vs underlying-release-in-window; report cutoff-edge candidates.
